Package dev.relism.flash.ext.security.saml

Class Saml

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.security.saml.Saml
All Implemented Interfaces:
Bound, SessionLogout, AutoCloseable
public final class Saml extends Object implements SessionLogout, Bound, AutoCloseable
SAML 2.0 for one app, as a service provider: Web Browser SSO into a Security session, and Single Logout both ways. Installed by SamlModule; a handler that connects providers at runtime takes it as a constructor parameter.

The application is one entity, <origin>/auth/saml/metadata, with one assertion consumer for every provider: a response is matched to its provider by Issuer, as a token by iss. SAML is not in the per-request chain: a request outside /auth/saml costs nothing, and a signed-in user is an ordinary session.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public void register(SamlIdp provider)
      Trusts another provider from now on: an organization connecting its own. Its metadata is fetched here, so a bad provider fails this call. It serves /auth/saml/{id}/login, but is not listed at /auth/methods: which provider a user signs in with is the application's call.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - the metadata is not over https on a public address, does not describe a usable provider, or its id or entity ID is another provider's
      IllegalStateException - the metadata could not be fetched or read

    • unregister

      public void unregister(String id)
      Stops trusting a provider: its responses are refused, its users' logouts stay local.

    • bind

      public void bind(Services services)
      Reads every configured provider's metadata, failing the boot with the reason, and encodes this application's. Needs SecurityModule.origin: the entity ID, the assertion consumer and the audience every assertion is checked against are built from it, never from a request's Host.
